Your local estimate counted only user messages, excluding the system prompt and tool definitions, so it doesn’t yet establish that the meter is wrong. I passed along your comparison and the console records; the request’s timestamp is available in UTC, but your count’s timezone and a full payload breakdown weren’t provided. Billing Engineering will check meter correctness and pass any needed correction to Billing Ops. I can’t promise a particular outcome or timing.

**Next:** Billing Engineering will review the case.
